db_subject: Discovery, characterization, and redesign of potent antimicrobial thanatin orthologs from Chinavia ubica and Murgantia histrionica targeting E. coli LptA.
db_measure: Discovery: initially reported in ref based on sequence homology analysis. Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (75%) to N-terminal deleted thanatin V16M C=T=K: 13%, R: 19%. GRAVY: -0.7875; mol Wt: 1970.392, mol formula: C86H145N27O21S2, mol ex coeff: 3105. Chemical modification: a disulfide bond C6-C13. Activity: active against Gram- E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 2 uM), S. enterica ATCC 14028 (MIC 1 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 13883 (MIC 1-2 uM), Gram+ bacteria S. pyogenes ATCC 19615 (MIC 1 uM), and E-faecalis ATCC 29212 (MIC> 16 uM) (Abdullah et al., 2025). MOA:bacteria: permeate outer memrbanes (OM) and binds to the Lpt system (LptA-G) involved in transporting LPS to OM. Structure: free in water and bound to LPS (via tr-NOESY).
